1) SOC 2 PDF: we have the finalized Type II report (period 2024-01-01 to 2025-06-30). I'll attach the redacted PDF suitable for customer sharing.

2) Bridge letter: yes, we can provide a short bridge letter. Our standard practice is to state the last covered period (ending 2025-06-30) and confirm no material control changes since then and that controls remain in place through a stated interim date. For procurement purposes I can draft language that covers continuity through 2026-09-30. Auditor concurrence is not required for a bridge letter, but we note in the letter that the last independent assessment was performed by Redwood's PCAOB-affiliated auditor (include contact upon request).

3) SIG/CAIQ: we can populate high-level answers within a week for the public-facing sections; sensitive artifacts (detailed logs, raw incident tickets) require redaction or an NDA. I will prepare a partial SIG spreadsheet with references to internal artifacts and provide guidance on what we can attach.

- Redwood_SOC2_TypeII_2025-06-30.pdf (redacted)
- draft_bridge_letter_NovaMed_2026-08-04.docx (internal draft)
- SIG_questionnaire_partials.xlsx (high-level answers + notes)

- Marissa/Ben/Jordan to review draft bridge and SIG partials; aim to finalize for NovaMed by 2026-08-20.
